title: EvidenceRecord
description: A normalized unit of evidence that Chronos can retrieve, rank, cite, and reason over.

evidence_id.$comment: Unique Chronos identifier for this EvidenceRecord. Identifies the evidence object itself, independent of its source document or chunk.

evidence_granularity.$comment: Defines the granularity of this evidence. 'document' means the EvidenceRecord represents the normalized document as a whole. 'chunk' means it represents a specific portion of that document.

source_system.$comment: The external or upstream system/domain from which this evidence originated.

source_entity_type.$comment: Type of the original source object. Describes what the object was before Chronos normalized it.

source_entity_id.$comment: Identifier of the original object in the source system. Answers: 'What upstream object did this evidence originate from?'

document_id.$comment: Chronos identifier for the normalized document created from the source entity. One source entity may produce one or more normalized documents.

chunk_id.$comment: Chronos identifier for the specific chunk within the normalized document. Required to contain a value when evidence_granularity='chunk'; null when evidence_granularity='document'.

account_id.$comment: Optional business-context identifier linking this evidence to an account.

opportunity_id.$comment: Optional business-context identifier linking this evidence to a sales opportunity.

quote_id.$comment: Optional identifier linking the evidence to a quote.

quote_version_id.$comment: Optional identifier linking the evidence to a specific version of a quote.

document_class.$comment: Chronos semantic classification of the normalized document. Unlike source_entity_type, this describes how Chronos interprets the content.

text.$comment: The actual evidence text. For document-level evidence this may contain the normalized document text; for chunk-level evidence it contains only the chunk text.

authority.$comment: Describes the authority of the evidence so Chronos can distinguish, for example, official policy from customer statements or internal guidance.

provenance.$comment: Additional lineage information that cannot be represented by the primary source identifiers.

parent_entity_id.$comment: Optional identifier of a containing or parent source object. Example: an email message may have an email thread as its parent.

valid_from.$comment: Business-time start: when the information represented by this evidence became valid in the real world.

valid_to.$comment: Business-time end: when this information stopped being valid. Null means it is still considered valid or no end is known.

system_from.$comment: System-time start: when Chronos began storing this version of the EvidenceRecord.

system_to.$comment: System-time end: when Chronos stopped considering this version current. Null represents the current stored version.

permissions.$comment: Access-control metadata inherited or derived from the source content.

classification.$comment: Security classification assigned to the evidence.

allowed_roles.$comment: Roles authorized to retrieve or consume this evidence.

content_hash.$comment: Hash of the evidence content used for change detection, deduplication, and determining whether derived artifacts such as embeddings need regeneration.

embedding_metadata.$comment: Metadata describing the embedding generated for this EvidenceRecord. The embedding vector itself may live in the vector store rather than in this record.

model.$comment: Embedding model used to generate the vector.

version.$comment: Version of the embedding model or embedding pipeline.

dimensions.$comment: Number of dimensions in the generated embedding vector.
